src: At Synechron, as Technology Lead for DevOps and SRE, he led the on-prem to AWS migration of banking apps with ninety-nine point nine percent uptime, moved more than twenty workloads onto EKS, introduced Argo CD GitOps, taking deploys from weekly to daily, and cut AWS cost by twenty-five percent.
text: At Synechron, as Technology Lead for DevOps and SRE, he led the on-prem to AWS migration of banking apps with ninety-nine point nine percent uptime, moved more than twenty workloads onto EKS, introduced Argo CD GitOps, taking deploys from weekly to daily, and cut AWS cost by twenty-five percent.
